in_marathi.name: Dhruba
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky, Blue, Turquoise
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhruba हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhruba comes from the Sanskrit word ‘dhrubh’, meaning ‘sky’, ‘blue’, or ‘turquoise’. In Hindu mythology, Dhruba is the name of the celestial pole star that holds the heavens in place. It represents steadiness, strength, and reliability.
